name: Parameter sweep: x^3 - 2x - c for c = 2, 4, 6, 8

files.graphics.ostrin:
// Comparative figure: f(x; c) for every scenario, with each root marked.
import std.viz
import model

pub fn figure(c1: Float, c3: Float, c5: Float, c7: Float, r1: Float, r3: Float, r5: Float, r7: Float) -> String {
    xs = linspace(-2.5, 3.5, 121)
    mut fig = viz.figure("f(x; c) = x^3 - 2x - c, roots for c = 2, 4, 6, 8")
        .describe("the family sampled on 121 points; each scenario's root is marked on the axis")
        .labels("x", "f(x; c)")
        .xlim(-2.5, 3.5)
        .polished(caption: "roots by std.numeric.brent on [1, 3] for c = 2, 4, 6, 8", label_size: 13, animate: false)
        .line(xs, model.samples(xs, c1), label: "c = 2")
        .line(xs, model.samples(xs, c3), label: "c = 4")
        .line(xs, model.samples(xs, c5), label: "c = 6")
        .line(xs, model.samples(xs, c7), label: "c = 8")
        .scatter(array([r1, r3, r5, r7]), array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), label: "roots", color: "#d1495b", size: 6.0)
        .hline(0.0)
    fig.svg()
}
